This is a temporary review workflow for the frozen26-PR BPE series. It does not add benchmark files to the26 source commits.

The workflow rebuilds the pinned upstream, every PR endpoint, and the frozen original engine. English and Chinese inputs are the complete-line128MiB prefixes of the existing pinned Wikipedia recipe. The source recipe is reused from `Yikai-Liao/tokenizers-bpe-benchmarks@0fa8d08fc832b4f8f505e6bfb0f4637d0d29fad3`; the Rust processor/pipeline is the same public ByteLevel runner used for local measurements, with phase boundaries added outside hot loops. Inputs are regenerated from pinned public Parquet shards and checked against fixed byte counts and SHA256; corpus text is transferred through Actions artifacts rather than Git history.

Each version uses4 workers and3 independent processes per language. Time and per-process full maxRSS are summarized by their medians. The version's VM stays the same for its3 rounds; versions can run on different shared GitHub-hosted CPUs, so the output is for broad trends. CPU model, affinity, image version, memory/swap, individual measurements, exact models, phase events and nominal10ms RSS/swap samples are retained. Phase attribution in the report uses the run with median maxRSS.

All source versions use Rust1.98.1, opt3/fatLTO/codegen-units1 and the same canonical dependency version set. Actual feature edges follow each real PR. Builds finish before timing begins on that VM. Dependency/cache restoration is separate from timing. The ordinary frozen-original sources need only three progress-namespace import adaptations inside the current upstream crate shell, which are recorded in their source patch.

Upstream creates model references first; every version compares its full ID-ordered vocabulary and ordered merges to those references. Three rounds also check repeatability. The summary job checks168 samples (28 versions ×2 languages ×3 rounds), common compiler/profile/runner/observer/lock, and model hashes. A failed or incomplete job cannot be reported as a complete result. Rerun artifacts include the Actions run attempt, and summary chooses the latest completed attempt per version.

Only official `actions/checkout`, `actions/cache`, `actions/upload-artifact` and `actions/download-artifact` are used, pinned to commit SHAs. Rust is installed with native rustup; Python helpers are version-pinned. The workflow is triggered only on the dedicated CI branch or by manual dispatch. It neither opens PRs nor modifies source commits or main.
